summary: Iteration 11: Tested image upload flow (POST /api/upload-image, GET URL, POST /api/tag-points with images, GET /api/tag-points/:id). Fixed a critical syntax error in create.tsx (line 578 had '}────' instead of '}') that was crashing the entire frontend. After fix + expo restart, all wizard steps work correctly and submit button is present.
action_items: FIXED (in this iteration): Syntax error in create.tsx line 578 — '}────' replaced with '}' + comment header. This was breaking the entire frontend (Babel parse error, Metro CI=true served stale bundle).
Expo requires restart after any create.tsx change because Metro runs in CI=true mode (no file watching). Main agent should be aware of this when deploying code changes.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: create.tsx line 578 had '}────' — Unicode box-drawing character '─' embedded outside a comment caused Babel SyntaxError: 'Unexpected character ─'. This caused the entire app frontend to fail to load (white screen). Fixed to '}' + proper comment header.
Metro runs with CI=true in supervisor config — no file watching. Expo restart required after each code change. Previous iterations also noted this (iteration 9, 10).

uploadImage() helper (create.tsx line 561-578): Implementation looks correct post-fix — calls /api/upload-image with multipart FormData, returns URL. Called in parallel via Promise.all before POST /api/tag-points.
Navigation fix (handleSubmit): setTimeout(100ms) for router.replace after Alert.alert callback — correct fix for crash.
MOCKED: FullPreviewModal votes/ratings are static fake data (FAKE_VOTES_DATA, FAKE_RATING=4.7, FAKE_VOTES_COUNT=12) — intended as encouragement to publish.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 wizard steps + submit button all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created test tagpoints during backend testing: TEST_Iter11 Image Upload TagPoint, TEST_Iter11 Images Response Check, TEST_Iter11 Image Create Check, TEST_Iter11 No Images, TEST_Iter11 Multi-Image. These are visible in the home feed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 fixed a critical syntax error in create.tsx ('}────' on line 578 was a stray box-drawing character). After expo restart, the entire create wizard works: steps 1-5 load correctly, submit button 'Publier le TagPoint' is visible at preview step. Backend: /api/upload-image returns HTTP 200 + public URL at /api/uploads/{filename}, files are accessible at that URL (HTTP 200), POST /api/tag-points with images:[] stores and returns URLs in 'images' field. Metro CI=true requires expo restart after code changes. All 12 backend image upload tests pass.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Frontend white screen / SyntaxError in create.tsx
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Line 578 of create.tsx contained '}────' — the Unicode box-drawing character '─' (U+2500) was accidentally embedded directly in code (outside a comment), causing Babel to throw 'Unexpected character ─' SyntaxError. Metro bundler running in CI=true mode served the stale/error bundle.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: Load https://sport-hub-13.preview.emergentagent.com — white blank screen. Check expo logs: ERROR SyntaxError: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/create.tsx: Unexpected character '─'. (578:1)
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Replaced '}────' with '}\n// ─── Step 1: L\'essentiel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────' and restarted expo supervisor.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: After restart, app loads correctly, login works, all wizard steps 1-5 navigate correctly, submit button present at step 4 (preview).
